chunks: And in another report, he said:
"The people of the arāk have no hajj, and they are those who stand beneath the arāk trees."

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ: the people or those associated with a place or description
key_terms.الْأَرَاكِ: the arāk trees; a known landmark near the hajj standing area
key_terms.يَقِفُونَ: they stand, referring to the ritual standing

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on standing under the arāk trees during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the standing place connected to hajj rites. It declares invalid the hajj of those who stand under the arāk trees, indicating that standing there falls outside the valid boundary for the rite.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2981 - In another narration, Imam (as) said:
"Those who stand under the Araak trees have no valid Hajj, as they are not within the designated standing area (Arafat)."
